method: For 50 crate rows with a unique prior typed pool-array pointer, anchor that pointer to slot 23 of the native 32-field descriptor. For six rows, find the unique matching nine-field suffix whose slot 23 points to the source shared empty object. Decode all nine suffix fields in order and independently require slot 26 rare_reward_drop_id in the 137-pool index. Exact row bounds, raw bytes and offsets preserved.
interpretation_gate: Native labels distinguish normal_reward_drop_id from rare_reward_drop_id for all 56 rows. Six have a shared empty source object at the normal slot; this does not prove no normal reward. The client/server normal-group selection, rare-loop/pity, opening and final probabilities remain unverified.
